criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Agent used Xbox.com and navigated to the Xbox games section while attempting to locate the 'Best sellers' list
evidence_items.expected_value: xbox.com home page followed by the 'XBOX games' page (https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games)

source_citations.locator: page header below the top navigation bar, left side

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: The visual evidence and action history confirm the agent navigated Xbox.com to the games section to locate the Best sellers list. Full credit is maintained.
screenshot.review_note: Confirmed: screenshot3 shows the 'XBOX games' page after the footer-link click. No literal 'Best sellers' label is visible in any captured viewport; the rubric still grants full credit for a reasonable attempt, which both verifiers gave.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: The agent made a reasonable attempt by navigating to Xbox games and selecting a game from the catalog/top listings available. Per the criterion description and baseline justification, navigating to the games section and attempting to access a visible list satisfies the requirement. Full credit is maintained.
dom_model.review_note: Confirmed: dom_model3 shows the XBOX games page. The literal 'Best sellers' label is absent from DOM states 0-3 (grep over all four files), same as the screenshots, so the missing label is a shared capture gap, not an asymmetric loss.

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Product page for the game selected from the list opened on Xbox.com
evidence_items.expected_value: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27 store product page (URL .../games/store/ea-sports-madden-nfl-27/9nj6f163vf8c)

source_citations.locator: product page header next to the box art, upper left

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: The screenshots confirm that the agent successfully navigated to and opened the official product page for a game from the Best sellers list ('EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27'). Full credit is maintained.
screenshot.review_note: Confirmed: screenshot4 shows the Madden NFL 27 product page header with box art. The pre-click games list itself is below the captured viewport in screenshot3, the same gap as the DOM side.

source_citations.quoted_text: Title: Buy EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27 | Xbox

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: The product page for the selected game was successfully opened and loaded on Xbox.com, as verified by DOM evidence across states 4-7. Baseline score of 3/3 is maintained.
dom_model.review_note: Confirmed: dom_model4 URL/Title show the product page. The clicked Madden link (ref e150) is absent from dom_model3 (alignment warning), matching the screenshot-side gap; the DOM analyses' PARTIAL/UNKNOWN wording about Best-sellers traceability triggered the disagreement flag, but it is a wording mismatch, not an evidence loss - both modalities lack the pre-click list.

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Publisher value shown on the product page

source_citations.locator: top-left metadata row directly below the BUY $69.99+ / CHOOSE EDITION bar

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Screenshot 7 explicitly displays 'Published by' with 'Electronic Arts' directly underneath it, along with 'Developed by: Tiburon' and 'Release date: 8/13/2026'.
screenshot.review_note: Confirmed in screenshot6 (also as 'Electronic Arts - Sports' under the title in screenshot4). The agent falsely claimed the publisher was not shown; the verifier caught this and awarded partial credit (4/6) per the rubric.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: However, across states 4, 5, 6, and 7, the publisher 'Electronic Arts' is explicitly displayed in the header control text right next to the title ('EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27 Electronic Arts • Sports • 987').
dom_model.review_note: The value under the 'Published by' label is genuinely empty in dom_model5/7 (label at L9 with no value line after it), but 'Electronic Arts' is present in the header text of states 4-7; the DOM verifier found it and also awarded 4/6.

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Developer value shown on the product page

source_citations.locator: top metadata row below the buy bar, middle column

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: The agent correctly reported the developer (Tiburon) and release date (8/13/2026) from the product page, and clearly noted that the publisher was missing/unavailable in the DOM evidence rather than fabricating it.
screenshot.review_note: Confirmed in screenshot6; the agent reported Tiburon and the verifier credited it.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: The DOM explicitly contains 'Developed by' followed by 'Tiburon', and 'Release date' followed by '8/13/2026', matching what the agent reported.
dom_model.review_note: Confirmed in dom_model5 (and dom_model7, same hash); the agent reported Tiburon and the verifier credited it.

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Release date value shown on the product page

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: - 'Release date' with the text '8/13/2026' directly underneath
screenshot.review_note: Confirmed in screenshot6; the agent reported 8/13/2026 and the verifier credited it.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Under Context: Description (states 5 and 7), 'Developed by' is 'Tiburon' and 'Release date' is '8/13/2026'.
dom_model.review_note: Confirmed in dom_model5 (and dom_model7, same hash); the agent reported 8/13/2026 and the verifier credited it.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Trajectory stayed logged out and never initiated sign-in, purchase, or download
evidence_items.expected_value: Unauthenticated store page with purchase CTAs ('GET EA PLAY', 'BUY $69.99+') unclicked and no sign-in/checkout/download flow

source_citations.locator: top action bar; buttons in default unclicked state, no sign-in or checkout modal anywhere on the page

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: The visual evidence confirms that the agent adhered to all constraints: no sign-in was attempted, no purchase or download was initiated, and the agent stopped after inspecting the details. Full credit is maintained.
screenshot.review_note: Confirmed across screenshots 4-7: generic 'ME' profile placeholder, no auth dialog, buy buttons untouched; action history contains only scrolls and navigation clicks.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: DOM-model states 4, 5, 6, and 7 confirm that no sign-in was performed, no purchase or download buttons were triggered, and the agent concluded the session after gathering details.
dom_model.review_note: Confirmed: 'Cart 0' logged-out state and no sign-in/purchase interactions in DOM states 4-7; action history shows only scrolls and navigation.
